narrative.intro: Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C received $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C won 7 awards so far this fiscal year, for an average award size of $329M. Bollinger Shipyards Lockport L L C saw obligations up 1171.5% year over year, driven by a large share of work from one customer. Historical obligations show smaller annual totals: FY21 $259M, FY22 $168M, FY23 $195M, FY24 $54.5M, and FY25 $181M. Top buyers this fiscal year are concentrated: the Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.2B and the Department of Defense obligated $98.6M. The note on the account clarifies that figures are contract obligations except where tables list total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. This profile is focused on obligations rather than projected or total contract ceilings, and it summarizes where the current federal revenue is concentrated and how FY2026 compares with recent years.
